digest.component_or_area: Configuration and credential access control; composition ownership gates
propositions: Enforce centralized configuration ownership via a deterministic AST gate that rejects direct ambient reads, aliased getenv/environ access, backend property reloads, and undeclared credential names below approved provider seams.
Wire the ownership gate into both `make lint` and CI workflows alongside the existing field-consumption gate to prevent silent omissions.
Generate authoritative configuration precedence, lifecycle, and security documentation from schema and ownership registries, covering MCP/CLI exposure, restart rotation, and provider-neutral deltas.

Remove legacy ambient facades, migration exceptions, and per-job SSM paths only after structural gates pass, behavioral test suites pass, and bounded live canaries (provider, review-bot, reconciler) complete without credential leakage.
Maintain the snapshot-envelope compatibility floor as the sole supported rollback point; structural gates serve as change detectors, not replacements for behavioral oracles from prior stages.
